description: 3rd connection. 2nd connection (2026-09-28T22:17:58Z) never actually ran any of its own steps: the WRAPPER CL PROGRAM ITSELF failed to compile (CPD0043, DFTACTGRP/ACTGRP are not valid CRTSQLRPGI parameters - unlike CRTBNDRPG, CRTSQLRPGI takes its activation-group settings from the SOURCE MEMBER'S OWN ctl-opt line, per src/qrpglesrc/q0613s.sqlrpgle's own established precedent, which this manifest's CPQ0805B step had incorrectly copied the CRTBNDRPG-style keywords into). Because the wrapper never compiled, its own VFYLOG DELETE/INSERT logic never ran either, so that connection's own vfylog/run sections were silently reading STALE data left over from the 1st connection - NOT a fresh run, despite looking superficially identical (same job number, same timestamp as the 1st connection's own residue). CPQ0805B is fixed here (DFTACTGRP/ACTGRP removed from the CRTSQLRPGI command; Q0805B's own ctl-opt dftactgrp(*no) actgrp(*new) line, already in its source, governs this instead). Everything else in this manifest is unchanged from the 2nd connection's own intent - see this file's git history for the full original description (F0805A retest + first Q0805B attempt, self-contained JU0300/ZA0500/JU0900C recompiles for a same-connection diff against verify/part08-05-legacy-baseline/expected/golden-master.md).

steps.label: CPJU03
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPF0805A
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0805A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/F0805A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(F0805A) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZA05
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(ZA0500) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJU09
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPQ0805B
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/Q0805B)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0805B) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0805B) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)
